propositions: Jira rebar-id label is written before local CREATE event and binding are durably published; when final push is rejected on ephemeral runner and local state is lost, the label persists orphaned and blocks all healing paths.
binding_walk L10 guard unconditionally stands down when rebar-id label is present, preventing replay of lost adopts even when binding and local ticket are both missing.

Recovery extension detects marked-but-unstored keys (label == deterministic inbound id, no binding-store entry, no local ticket) and replays adopt through existing inbound-create leaf instead of standing down, re-materializing the binding idempotently.
Idempotent replay uses deterministic inbound local id as recovery key, ensuring replayed adopt converges to same local ticket, binding, and label without duplication.
L10 stand-down conditions remain protective for non-deterministic markers, existing store entries, and retired keys; bridge_fsck continues alerting unbound_jira until binding is healed.
